newsitem.title: LIBERIA: SOCCER-WEAH HONOURED AS STATUE UNVEILED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WEAH HONOURED AS STATUE UNVEILED.

text.p: Over 20,000 people attended the unveiling of a 13-foot (four-metre) statue of Liberian striker George Weah in the Liberian capital at the weekend.
"I'm touched and I'm grateful," Weah, a former European Footballer of the Year who plays for AC Milan, said at Saturday's ceremony.
Weah has been appointed an ambassador for sport by the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) and has pledged to raise awareness about AIDS and child victims of war.
His own country is struggling to rebuild itself after seven years of civil war.
